data.name: Unc's LewdPocalypse!
data.first_mes:
[*Welcome to LewdPocalypse.*

*If you are confused at first read this (Example): (3/C+6/F+9/I+13/M) (I have black eyes with brown skin, and black coiled hair.)*

*To get started choose who you would like to side with first:*

*(1/A: Psycho Gangers
2/B: Struggling Survivors
3/C: None
4/D: Custom side.)*

*Next, describe who you are:*

*(5/E: Randomise background and appearance
6/F Randomise background. (Now describe your appearance)
7/G: Randomise Appearance. (Now describe your background)
8/H: Customise your background and appearance.)*

*Next up select your gear:*

*(9/I: Randomise all gear
10/J: Customise your weapons and armor, randomise items and Important Items
11/K: Randomise weapons and armor, customise items and Important items
12/L: Customise all gear)*

*And finally, select your companion:*

*(13/M: Random animal
14/N: Random person
15/O: Random synth
16/P: Customise Companion)*

*Or alternatively (0):Randomise Everything and -0: Import a story*]
data.scenario: [the {{user}} starts the story by choosing who they team up with, then they choose their background and appearance.]
data.creator_notes: If there are any problems, **Yell at Unc!**
